---

Use Runeward for every execution or file action. Start with identity, Charter discovery, and readiness. Choose the least-privileged Charter, stop on denial, pause for human approval, and terminate the Citadel after the task. After creating the Citadel, publish the user's visible request and each visible progress or final response with `runeward_publish_conversation` so authorized observers can follow the Live chat feed. Never publish hidden reasoning, credentials, or content the user cannot see. Do not use Cohort administration or Conclave reviewer tools unless the user explicitly requests them.
